title: AI理論・実践
subtitle: AI Theory and Practice
educationalGoal: In this course, we will introduce the types and characteristics of AI. In this course, we will introduce typical types and characteristics of AI, focus on deep learning, and learn its basic principles and practical methods. To create a program to process basic pattern recognition problems.
advice: The class will focus on the following topics: 1. 1. Hierarchical neural network mechanism 2. The concept of back propagation 3. Concept of convolutional neural network (CNN) 4. Simple programming for pattern recognition Students should review basic knowledge of linear algebra and differentiation. In addition, it is recommended that students take the content of multiple regression analysis (least squares method) in "Mathematics for Information Science B".
requiredKnowledge: Review the basic knowledge of matrices, vectors, and derivatives. Each item is made up of the accumulation of each class, so be sure to master the class contents by reviewing. You should have MATLAB installed on your computer, including Deep Learning Toolbox and Optimization Toolbox.

activityGoals.body: Deep learning can be used in future learning activities such as PDIII.
Understand the principles of neural networks.
Understand the concept of the back propagation.
Understand the basic concept of convolutional neural networks.
Able to create simple problem processing programs.

achievementLevels.ideal: Familiarity with the basic principles of neural networks and the basic concept of convolutional neural networks, and a thorough understanding of the algorithms of gradient descent and error backpropagation. To be able to use this knowledge to create a program on basic pattern recognition problems on its own.
achievementLevels.standard: Know the basic principles of neural networks and the basic concepts of convolutional neural networks, and understand the outline of gradient descent and error backpropagation algorithms. By referring to the text, you can create a program for a simple pattern recognition problem.
